sections.title: New Map: Malevento
sections.description: Our newest Free-For-All Map is Malevento, a peaceful Italian hilltop town with a cursed past! Battle along the cliff's edge for dominance of the majestic Duomo di Malevento. Circle your opponents beneath the mournful stone eyes of Caterina Pastore, a Renaissance painter with a tragic past, or plot the downfall of your enemies in the mysterious safe house. Will you find victory in these twisting streets, or will the curse of Malevento claim you too?
